command_ordering: Every ordinary accepted LLD-02 command follows LLD-01 ordering: idempotency check -> pure bounded preflight -> open UnitOfWork -> load/revalidate authoritative state -> allocate immutable IDs -> insert command_receipt -> domain/lifecycle writes -> audit -> commit. Any later failure rolls the receipt back with the command.
preflight_rule: Pure normalization, field-bound checks and syntax validation occur before BEGIN IMMEDIATE where possible; every state-dependent precondition and uniqueness/eligibility decision is revalidated inside the authoritative UnitOfWork. No external I/O, DNS, operator wait or unbounded computation occurs while the write transaction is held.

commands.name: CreateCustomerOrganization
commands.transaction_boundary: one LLD-01 authoritative UnitOfWork after pure preflight
steps: validate semantic bounds and compute governed match keys in pure preflight
inside UnitOfWork, when account code supplied detect any active different claimant and return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW with no mutation
allocate customer_org_id, optional identifier_id and lifecycle_event_id
insert command_receipt
insert active record revision 1
insert optional active customer_account_code identifier referencing receipt
append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
insert audit/result references
commit
rules: matching candidates may be shown before command but equal name never blocks creation solely as identity duplication
Customer Account Code is preferred external matching evidence but never the relational ID
reviewed duplicate-code preservation uses ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim after Customer creation; ordinary create does not silently create a multiply claimed code
no implicit merge/adoption

commands.name: SetCustomerAccountCode
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after bounded normalization preflight
steps: normalize complete account code in pure preflight
inside UnitOfWork load active Customer and revalidate revision
query active canonical claimants for exact normalized code
if any other Customer claims the code return ACCOUNT_CODE_CONFLICT_REVIEW with bounded claimant identities/count and no mutation
allocate identifier ID
insert command_receipt
supersede this Customer's prior active account-code row when different
insert new active claim when not already the same accepted value
increment Customer revision when canonical claim changes
insert audit referencing superseded/new identifier identities
commit
rules: prior claims remain history
same already-active code under same Customer is idempotent only through normal command-receipt semantics
source/import observations never call this without reviewed acceptance

commands.name: ConfirmCustomerAccountCodeSharedClaim
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed acceptance that one normalized Customer Account Code currently has more than one canonical Customer Organization claimant
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after bounded normalization preflight
steps: require nonempty reviewed conflict context
inside UnitOfWork load active target Customer and revalidate revision
normalize/revalidate exact code and load bounded identities/count of existing active claimants
require at least one different active claimant or reject as wrong command path
allocate identifier ID
insert command_receipt
supersede target Customer's different active account-code claim when present
insert active shared claim for target Customer without mutating other claimants
increment target Customer revision
insert audit carrying review_context_id and every affected local identifier identity plus bounded existing-claimant summary
commit
rules: does not merge Customers
does not silently choose a winner
future account-code matching remains AMBIGUOUS while multiple active claimants remain
other claimant records/history are untouched
this command is unavailable to safe auto-accept paths

commands.name: ReassignCustomerAccountCode
commands.purpose: explicit reviewed resolution moving one active account-code claim from one Customer Organization to another
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after bounded normalization preflight
steps: inside UnitOfWork require distinct active Customers and revalidate both revisions
normalize/revalidate exact code and prove from-Customer has an active claim for that code
allocate new identifier ID
insert command_receipt
supersede from-Customer account-code claim
supersede any different active account-code claim on to-Customer
insert active code claim for to-Customer
increment both Customer revisions
insert one reasoned audit action referencing changed identifier/Customer identities and review_context_id
commit
rules: does not merge Customer Organizations
does not rewrite historical operational Customer context
does not silently supersede any third Customer that also has the same reviewed active claim; such remaining claimants keep the code ambiguous
cannot be triggered merely by equal display names
failure anywhere rolls all claim/revision/audit changes back

commands.name: CreateContact
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure name/channel validation
steps: validate/normalize name and optional email through ContactChannelPolicy before opening write transaction
inside UnitOfWork validate referenced active Customer when supplied
allocate contact_id plus optional channel/affiliation/lifecycle IDs
insert command_receipt
insert active Contact
insert optional active validated email channel
insert optional current affiliation referencing receipt
append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
insert audit/result references
commit
rules: zero affiliation and zero communication channels are valid
equal name/email candidate evidence never silently selects an existing Contact
initial affiliation preserves Contact identity independence

commands.name: UpdateContactDescriptiveData
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure name validation
steps: compute governed name match key in pure preflight
inside UnitOfWork load immutable active Contact and revalidate revision
allocate lifecycle_event_id
insert command_receipt
update Contact name/name_match_key and increment revision
append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event
insert audit/result references including bounded prior/new descriptive evidence
commit
rules: does not change contact_id, affiliation or channels
channel changes use dedicated commands
historical operational snapshots owned elsewhere are never rewritten

commands.name: AddContactChannel
steps: validate and normalize matching key in pure preflight
inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and revalidate Contact revision
allocate contact_channel_id
insert command_receipt
insert active channel revision 1
increment Contact revision so stale aggregate editors detect membership change
insert audit referencing Contact/channel identities and bounded value delta
commit
rules: equal channel values are allowed
adding a channel never merges Contacts
no DNS/network/deliverability check occurs

commands.name: UpdateContactChannel
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and active owned channel; revalidate both revisions
insert command_receipt
update stored value_text/match_key and increment channel revision
increment Contact revision
insert audit with bounded prior/new value evidence
commit
rules: channel_kind is immutable for a channel identity; changing kind requires archive + add
generated communication snapshots owned by LLD-09 remain unchanged

commands.name: ArchiveContactChannel
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and active owned channel; revalidate both revisions
insert command_receipt
set channel lifecycle_state archived and increment channel revision
increment Contact revision
insert audit
commit
rules: archive does not delete the channel row
archived channel no longer participates in matching or recipient selection
underlying Contact and operational records remain valid

commands.name: ChangeContactAffiliation
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active Contact and current affiliation
validate new Customer is active when non-null
resolve idempotent replay through receipt lookup before mutation
allocate new affiliation ID when needed
insert command_receipt
close current affiliation row when present using accepted occurrence time
insert new current affiliation row when non-null referencing receipt
increment Contact revision
insert audit referencing relationship change
commit
rules: same Contact identity is retained
historical affiliation rows are never rewritten to current
name equality cannot authorize this command
operational records preserve their own organization-at-use context

commands.name: CreateStandaloneDispatchLocation
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure field validation
steps: validate nonblank bounded name/address and compute name_match_key before opening write transaction
inside UnitOfWork allocate dispatch_location_id and lifecycle_event_id
insert command_receipt
insert active address_mode standalone
append created lifecycle event referencing receipt
insert audit/result references
commit
rules: no Customer ownership/preference relationship is created
operation role is not written to the master

commands.name: CreateDedicatedDispatchLocationForSite
commands.visibility: cross-domain service used by LLD-08 coordinator, not standalone public commit
steps: require caller has completed bounded preflight plus idempotency/revalidation and inserted the shared command_receipt in this UnitOfWork
allocate dispatch_location_id/lifecycle_event_id
insert active address_mode site_derived with null standalone address
append created lifecycle event referencing shared receipt
return identity/event to LLD-08 coordinator which inserts the one-to-one Site relation and final audit/result references before shared commit
commands.rule: failure of Site/relation/audit creation rolls back Dispatch Location, lifecycle event and receipt in the same UnitOfWork

commands.name: UpdateReferenceDescriptiveData
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after pure field validation/normalization
steps: inside UnitOfWork load active target and revalidate revision/lifecycle eligibility
allocate lifecycle_event_id
insert command_receipt
apply change and increment revision
append descriptive_corrected lifecycle event
insert audit/result references with bounded prior/new evidence
commit
rules: cannot change immutable ID
Customer Account Code is changed only through dedicated governed commands and not generic descriptive update
Dispatch Location cannot change customer ownership because no such field exists
site_derived address cannot be overwritten here; Site address is owned by LLD-08

commands.name: ArchiveReference
commands.ordering: archive algorithm uses bounded guard checks inside the write UnitOfWork and inserts receipt only after every guard passes

commands.name: ReactivateReference
commands.ordering: reactivation algorithm uses bounded guard checks inside the write UnitOfWork and inserts receipt only after every guard passes

commands.name: WriteSetting
commands.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork after strict JSON + state-independent semantic preflight
steps: outside write transaction resolve closed SettingDefinition, perform strict JSON validation and any state-independent semantic validation
inside UnitOfWork revalidate persisted revision/absence and run only bounded state-dependent owner checks through explicit interfaces
insert command_receipt
INSERT new row or UPDATE existing row explicitly with next revision; SQL REPLACE is forbidden
insert audit
commit
rules: no external I/O or operator wait inside state-dependent validation
no write occurs merely because a default exists
unknown setting key is rejected
secret-classified settings are rejected from this store and routed to LLD-12-owned storage

commands.name: CreateLocalUserProfileIdentity
input: existing UnitOfWork from LLD-12 setup coordinator
steps: require caller's shared setup command ordering/idempotency contract
require no singleton row
validate bounded username before transaction or before calling this helper
insert singleton metadata identity
return without internal commit
commands.rule: LLD-12 owns verifier/auto-login creation and the coordinator commits metadata+required authentication state atomically or rolls all back
